rights.pageSubtitle: Understanding your constitutional rights during encounters with immigration enforcement
rights.disclaimerText: This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Every situation is different. For advice about your specific circumstances, please consult with a qualified immigration attorney.
rights.rightSilentDesc: You do not have to answer questions about where you were born, your immigration status, or how you entered the United States.
rights.rightSilentPhrase: Say: "I am exercising my right to remain silent."
rights.rightAttorneyDesc: You have the right to speak with a lawyer before answering any questions. If detained, you can make phone calls.
rights.rightAttorneyPhrase: Say: "I want to speak to a lawyer."
rights.rightNoSignDesc: Do not sign anything without speaking to an attorney. Signing "voluntary departure" can waive your right to a hearing.
rights.rightNoSignPhrase: Say: "I do not want to sign anything until I speak with my attorney."
rights.rightNoLieDesc: Never provide false information or fake documents. This can result in criminal charges and bars to future immigration relief.
rights.rightNoLiePhrase: Stay silent rather than make up answers.
rights.warrantSubtitle: Understanding the difference can protect your rights. Only a JUDICIAL warrant allows entry into your home.
rights.atHomeDesc: If ICE comes to your door
rights.detainedTitle: If You or a Loved One Is Detained
rights.consularTitle: Your Right to Contact Your Consulate
rights.consularText: Under the Vienna Convention, if you are detained, you have the right to contact your country's consulate.
rights.consularPhrase: Say: "I want to contact my consulate."

about.title: How ICEwhistle Works
about.subtitle: Transparency & Privacy
about.tagline: No accounts. No tracking. Location rounded for privacy.
about.taglineDesc: ICEwhistle is designed to protect your privacy while helping communities stay informed. We collect the minimum data necessary and never track you.
about.step1Desc: Your exact coordinates are never stored. We round to a 500m grid, which covers roughly 4-6 city blocks.
about.step2Desc: We add a random offset of ±100m so even the grid position is unpredictable. This makes it impossible to reverse-engineer your exact location.
about.step3Desc: Reports identify a general area, not a specific address. You cannot be identified by your report location.
about.openSourceDesc: ICEwhistle is open source. Anyone can review the code to verify these privacy claims.

support.title: Support this tool
support.intro: This tool is free, ad-free, and available to everyone.
support.mission: It is maintained as a public resource to help people understand their rights, share timely information, and access community support during ICE encounters. No account is required, and no usage data is tracked.
support.transparency: Contributors may receive modest stipends for maintenance or translation work. These expenses are reported transparently. Any surplus funds may be redistributed to aligned community organizations or mutual aid efforts.
